parameters.note: Tulloch Lake is not listed in CCR §7.40(b) or §7.50(b), so it falls under the general statewide lake regulation in §5.85(a)(1).

candidates.summary: Open all year (general statewide lake regulation; not listed as a special-regulation water)

schedule.note: CDFW's 2026 Provisional Stocking Document for Trout and Inland Salmon lists Tulloch Lake (Region 4, Tuolumne Co.) for sub-catchable-size Brown Trout under the Put and Grow program, with stated release month ranges of January-April and October-December (the October-through-April winter window; May-September is not included). This is CDFW's provisional plan for 2026, not a guaranteed annual constant.

CDFW's 2026 Provisional Stocking Document for Trout and Inland Salmon lists Tulloch Lake (Region 4, Tuolumne Co.) for catchable-size Rainbow Trout under the Put and Take program, with stated release month ranges of January-April and October-December (the October-through-April winter window; May-September is not included). This is CDFW's provisional plan for 2026, not a guaranteed annual constant.
